parameters.summary: Created a fully functional React calculator application with a modern UI design. The calculator supports basic arithmetic operations (+, -, ×, ÷), decimal numbers, percentage calculations, sign toggle, and clear functionality. Features a beautiful gradient background with a clean, iOS-style interface.
next_steps: Navigate to the calculator directory: cd calculator
Start the development server: npm run dev
Open your browser to the URL shown (usually http://localhost:5173)
